page.overview:
What is Adventure Nightmare Balloon Boy?

, also commonly referred to as Adventure Nightmare BB, is an unlockable character added in the 1.2 update for FNaF World. He can be unlocked by beating Foxy Fighters with an A rank.

Nightmare Balloon Boy's appearance seems identical to counterpart from the core series, but smaller and "cuter," with shorter legs and larger eyes with slightly small pupils.

{| class="article-table" style="width: 55%;" border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1"

Nightmare Balloon Boy is an extremely powerful character to use and one of the two characters that is needed for the Geist Lair. Nightmare Balloon Boy has Mega Bite that can do huge damage to an enemy and others nearby.
